What started as me calling out a company for a defective product ended with them flying me out, showing me exactly what happened, and explaining how they’re ensuring it doesn't happen again. This is the level of accountability all companies should strive for. Every business will eventually mess up, but integrity is defined by how you handle those failures. While I don't take any company's word at face value, the fact that in 2024-2025 I was seeing more of their PCs coming into my shop for upgrades instead of repairs proves their changes have actually stuck.
